prompt: Build for this brief: A cultural venue; visitors browse works, plan visits and find events. Use Burgundy and Rose: page #FFF8FA, text #48232E, accent #9D244E, secondary surface #F7DBE5, text on accent #FFFFFF. Set headings in Libre Baskerville and reading text in Inter; traditional serif heading with compact interface text. Composition: Single reading column, left aligned headings, marginal metadata, thin section rules. Use body 14px, heading 64px, line height 1.3, reading measure at most 56ch, gap 24px, content width at most 960px and item radius 0px. Keep letter spacing zero. At 390px use a single reading order, preserve required text and provide access to every control. Use real subject imagery when needed, not ornamental blobs. Check rendered text contrast and overflow; never call this recipe proven beautiful.
